messages:
maria: Hey team — just got a ticket from a customer: their integration with our JSON-mode /function call flow started failing in prod around 12:07 UTC. They get a 400 with "invalid tool args".

maria: Pasting minimal repro from them: they call our API with function signature for "create_order" and the model returns a function_call but the args are malformed (nulls + missing keys).

maria: ```json
Request body (from user):
{
  "model": "rwd-std-1",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "create order for item 123 qty 2" }],
  "functions": [{
    "name": "create_order",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "item_id": { "type": "string" },
        "qty": { "type": "integer" }
      },
      "required": ["item_id", "qty"]
    }
  }],
  "function_call": "auto"
}

Model function_call (what they received):
{
  "name": "create_order",
  "arguments": null
}
```

jordan: Oof. So the model returned a function call but arguments were literally null. Customer says this started after yesterday's small tweak to the system prompt + we pushed a minor inference config change at 08:30 UTC.

lee: @maria can you attach the raw response headers + request-id so I can correlate to ingress logs? Also which SDK / version are they on?

maria: Request-ID: req_0a7d3f9, SDK: python-sdk v0.12.1. Headers: x-region: us-west-2, x-deploy: prod-blue.

maria: Customer provided a second example where the model returned a partial JSON string (missing closing brace) which causes our parser to throw a parse error instead of a clear tool-schema-mismatch error.

maria: ```
Model partial output: {"item_id": "123", "qty": 2

--end--
```

sophie: Two separate issues maybe: (A) model deciding to call function but not emitting args (null) — could be model hallucination/early stop. (B) model producing truncated JSON — maybe streaming cut-off or tokenization edge.

sophie: Quick checks: are we applying any postprocessing that coerces empty-string -> null anywhere? Also check for our streaming chunk joiner dropping last chunk on chunk-boundary \u2014 saw that before.

lee: I pulled the logs for req_0a7d3f9: inference runtime returned a final event with role:tool name:create_order and content: null at 2026-03-15T12:07:04Z. No stream partials recorded in our aggregator because the event had final=true.

lee: From the runtime trace it looks like sequence ended with a '' token followed by EOS. I'm attaching the token-level dump to the internal ticket.

maria: Customer is blocked. They said their downstream service rejects null args and they can't proceed.

jordan: Priority P1 for support engineering — customer on paying plan + production. Escalating to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

deploy-bot: New deploy to prod-blue completed at 08:32 UTC (commit: b7c3f9c).

lee: Noting correlation: deploy at 08:32 UTC, first errors ~12:07. Might be unrelated, but we'll keep range open.

sophie: Hypothesis: model prompt change or temperature drift leading to different function_call behavior. I'll run the same prompt against rwd-std-1 and rwd-safe-1 locally with our function schema and force deterministic sampling to see if we can reproduce null args.

sophie: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl to our hosted endpoint with the exact JSON-mode functions object (see above).
2) log full streaming events.
3) compare with model-side raw tokens.

sophie: I can reproduce a null-arguments function_call when the model outputs only the function name and decides not to include an args object, but only at high temperature (>0.9) or when system prompt contains trailing "" markers.

lee: Important: we should not treat null as valid args. Parser should raise a schema-mismatch and return an error that indicates missing required keys, not attempt to call downstream tool. For now, advise customer to validate server-side that args != null and return 400 with friendly message.

maria: Customer wants workaround asap. Can we add a temporary gateway check to block tool-call events with null args and return a structured error so they can retry?

lee: Yes. I'll add a quick filter in the API edge: if function_call.arguments == null or not a string, return 422 with body {"error":"tool_args_invalid", "reason":"arguments missing or null"}. Patch ETA 2h.

sophie: Also adding a postprocessing sanitizer: if model returned truncated JSON (partial string), attempt to run a safe fixer: close braces if unbalanced and run a strict JSON parse. This is heuristic but will reduce breakage. Mark as opt-in.

jordan: Great. Please add a note to the status/incident thread and notify the customer channel with ETA.

lee: Patch created: GH PR rwd/runtime#4523 — server-side early validation + structured error. Deploy to prod-blue in canary in ~90m.

maria: Sent customer a message with temporary mitigation + our ETA. They replied: "thank you, blocking issue but appreciate quick response" :thumbsup:

sophie: Follow-ups:
- Add unit tests for null-argument responses (we didn't have one).
- Add telemetry metric for "function_call with null args".
- Add guidance to docs: recommend SDK consumers to validate args before calling downstream tools.

lee: Monitoring: I'll instrument a Prometheus counter and alert if rate > 1/min for 10m.

maria: Closing loop once canary green and customer confirms.

jordan: Thanks all — good triage.

sophie: Postmortem note: likely combo of subtle prompt change + model scoring variance + our missing defensive checks. Will write short postmortem after RCA.

maria: marking this thread for follow-up and will attach customer confirmation before closing.
